citations.quote: We further assume that the rvs N and (Xk) are independent; in that case we refer to (13.9) as a compound sum.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Operational-risk quantification builds a compound aggregate-loss random variable S_N = X_1 + ··· + X_N from a frequency distribution (typically Poisson, in the Panjer (a,b)-class) and a heavy-tailed severity distribution; the aggregate distribution is computed via Panjer recursion, convolution-FFT, or Monte Carlo and tail-dominated by the one-large-loss principle.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Operational Risk Quantification — McNeil Ch.13 §13.2
